# Matt Fowles

> Product creator and builder with a fintech and martech background. Based in Albania, working across Continental Europe in English.

Matt Fowles (https://mattfowl.es) is a product creator and builder. His background is in fintech and martech.

He builds web, mobile, desktop, internal tools, and AI built into products.

He is based in Albania and works across Continental Europe in English.

[Flumin](https://flumin.io) is his legal-tech platform.

There is no contact form and no phone number on the site. Make contact with a written enquiry to POST https://mattfowl.es/api/contact

The route accepts `application/json` or a form post. Fields:

- name (required)
- email (required)
- company (optional)
- message (required)

A successful enquiry returns `{ "ok": true }`.

## Languages

- [English](https://mattfowl.es/): default. URLs have no language prefix. `/en` redirects here.
- [Shqip](https://mattfowl.es/sq): Albanian. URLs use the `/sq` prefix.
